avdCost.note: Same page, 60 s per run, synthetic tone on a real AudioTrack. Emulated GPU: compares themes, not a phone benchmark.

attempts: Part-by-part measurement showed 44% of a core even without Santa and without cover bulbs: the seek and play ring timers were redrawing the window out of phase. One shared clock replaced them.
A 24 fps shared clock was tried and rejected: Santa frames come from the render thread and did not align with it, giving more frames and more CPU.
After the shared clock, Santa never started when decoding finished after the first check. One run measured 15% at 15 fps because of that bug. Fixed; that number is not a valid result.
First QML render showed only lit bulbs: a garland.layer leftover resolved to the Item layer property and produced an invalid image URL. Fixed, and the test now requires both baked layers to load.
First Android seasonal run failed on a test that sampled outside the painted cover. Test corrected; the product was not at fault.
CI personal-library failed: its Qt lacked the optional qtimageformats module, so WebP did not decode. CI now installs it and Windows packaging refuses to run without qwebp.dll.
CI android-components failed at Enable KVM before any project test ran: /dev/kvm was unavailable on the runner. The same halloweenTests action passed on the dedicated AVD.
First seam candidates showed a double Santa or a double mug. Pose matching alone was not enough; the final seam sits at a slow part of the motion and uses DIS optical flow.
